capabilities: Save scroll and cursor position per note
Restore positions for all open tabs on app restart
Save positions in both editing and reading modes
Configure save interval, restore delay, and max stored entries
extras: Not yet listed in the official Community Plugins directory; installation is via BRAT or manual download from GitHub releases.
intentEvidence: All open tabs restore their positions on app restart, not just the last active one
problem: Obsidian does not remember where you were reading or editing in each note, so reopening tabs or restarting the app loses your position.
summary: Scroll Anchor saves and restores each note's scroll and cursor position across all open tabs, even after an app restart on mobile.
